en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning issued early Saturday as heavy rain spreads
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 2.35 a.m., saying heavy rain exceeding 30 mm an hour has fallen or is expected generally across the territory and may continue.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 2.35 a.m. on Saturday, indicating that heavy rain of more than 30 millimetres an hour has been recorded or is expected over widespread areas of Hong Kong and is likely to persist.

The Observatory said some low-lying and poorly drained places may experience flooding. Members of the public who could be affected were advised to take necessary precautions. Heavy rain may also trigger flash floods, and people should stay away from watercourses.

Earlier special weather tips had warned that areas of thunderstorms near the Pearl River Estuary were expected to bring heavier showers and strong gusts to parts of the territory in the following hours. The public was urged to remain alert to changing conditions and to follow the latest Observatory updates.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨警告凌晨生效 廣泛地區有大雨
zh.dek: 天文台於凌晨2時35分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，指本港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時超過30毫米的大雨，雨勢可能持續。
body: 香港天文台於星期六凌晨2時35分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，表示本港廣泛地區已錄得或預料會有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨，且雨勢可能持續。
天文台指出，一些低窪地帶及排水欠佳的地區可能出現水淹，可能受影響的市民應採取適當預防措施。大雨亦可能引致山洪暴發，市民應遠離河道。
較早前天文台已發出特別天氣提示，指珠江口一帶持續有雷雨區發展，預料未來數小時本港部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴，呼籲市民提高警覺並留意最新天氣消息。
